story: An early three-man breakaway was formed after 20 kilometres, later joined by Pavel Novák. A runaway kangaroo caused chaos in the peloton, bringing down GC leader Vine and forcing teammate Bjerg to abandon. The break was caught with one lap remaining, late attackers Buitrago, Glivar and Cepeda were neutralised in the final kilometre and Brennan won the uphill bunch sprint.
